definitions.arrival_quantiles: inverse-CDF quantiles of arrival_from_group_ns weighted by sensor weighted_energy_eV
definitions.effective_multiplicity: energy inverse-participation ratio: (sum channel E)^2/sum(channel E^2)
definitions.hit_multiplicity: number of L{layer}:P{pixel} channels with positive sensor energy
definitions.original_event_merge: event_map group_key with terminal |L{layer} removed; all layer groups having that original key are summed, while direct_tes_keV is added once
definitions.packet_mc_eta_standard_error: Weighted Bernoulli sensor-vs-nonsensor plug-in SE. Terminal branches are energy-weighted; Kish branch n_eff is capped by independently launched primary_packet_count because hits.csv lacks branch ancestry. Primary packets are assumed independent. This is conservative against treating down-conversion branches as independent, but excludes surface/model/geometry systematics and has zero plug-in SE at eta boundaries.
definitions.roi_probability: Gaussian integral over [510.58,511.42) keV centered on reconstructed_mean
definitions.sensor_eta: sensor weighted terminal energy / Si input energy
definitions.time_bands: prompt <1 us; intermediate 1 us <= t <10 us; late >=10 us
